assessments.reasoning: osi_terms contains the complete grant and its immediately following condition in the authenticated November 24 revision of record 395. Reading both paragraphs preserves the stated modality.

limitations: Application to an actual work requires evidence of the governing grant and the licensor’s authority. Implied patent rights and third-party rights remain unresolved.
reasoning: Record 395, content.rendered, div#LicenseText paragraph 1 grants permission free of charge to any person obtaining a copy of the defined Software. It expressly lists use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies, and permits the person to allow those to whom the Software is furnished to do so. Its closing words subject the grant to the conditions that follow. Paragraph 2 states the notice condition.
